title: Set in Stone Album Cover
coreRelationships: The marble bust's texture and details contrast with the soft, fluffy texture of the fur coat.
The metallic sheen of the gold and diamonds provides a focal point and adds a touch of opulence.
The dark, bold typography stands out against the light background and the figure's shoulder.
The overall monochromatic scheme is punctuated by the warm gold tones of the jewelry and the deep red of the main title.
reuseFormula: Recreate a luxurious, monochromatic portrait of a figure rendered in marble, adorned with fur and prominent jewelry. Integrate bold, condensed sans-serif typography for the main title and artist name (with custom character substitutions), an elegant serif for the subtitle, and an ornate script element, all positioned to complement the figure and background.
